changelog: v3.1.9 - BUG FIX (FIX-VI-CAPTURE): The selfie capture button required faceDetected=true before it could be clicked. The skin-tone face-detection algorithm fails for many students (particularly darker skin tones), permanently blocking the selfie step and preventing course navigation. Fix: capture button is now enabled immediately when the camera starts. Face detection continues to run and provides visual feedback (tick/frame highlight + hint text) but no longer gates the button. If a student can see themselves in the camera, they can always capture. No DB schema changes. templates/student_view.mustache only. version.php → 2026041600319.
v3.1.8 - FIX: version number corrected to 13-digit YYYYMMDD00XXX format. No DB schema changes.
